title: BLOOM RING
why: His yes to a bloom ring. The outer ring round your cursor (the one that counts your rounds, and the one that fills while you reload) now tells you how steady your aim is. It sits wider when you walk, wider again when you sprint or roll, and swells a little with every shot; it closes in when you stand still and tightens further when you crouch. The crosshair style and colour rows still decide how it looks. It tells the truth, too: the spread of every round you fire now follows the ring. Standing still is exactly as accurate as before, crouching is a tenth tighter, walking is about a sixth looser and sprinting and shooting about a third, with steady aim (right mouse) keeping its big tightening. This is a balance change, which his rule of 2 October allows, and the seeded stream does not move.
now: The cursor outer ring widens when you move, sprint or shoot and tightens when you stand or crouch, and your spread follows it.
